input_fields.name: baseline_file
input_fields.description: Readable baseline path, size, source hash, and ownership classification.

input_fields.name: run_copy_path
input_fields.description: Independent run-owned destination path and overwrite policy.

result_fields.name: copy_identity
result_fields.description: Source/destination paths, sizes, hashes, and copy timestamp.

result_fields.name: baseline_integrity
result_fields.description: One of preserved, mismatch, or needs_manual_review.

procedure: Resolve source/destination paths without an unsafe alias or overwrite collision.
Read source hash, copy bytes to the run-owned destination, then hash the destination.
Return both identities and compare size/SHA-256; preserve mismatch as failed copy.
Do not open, edit, save, or delete a native model.
rejection_rules: Reject missing/unreadable source, destination collision with baseline/evidence, or unowned destination.
Do not delete or overwrite a path with unclear ownership.
